motivation: The retrospective Tampa mechanism line is hard-stopped. The next permitted mechanism evidence must use genuinely new state information. The public tbep-tech/otb-temp continuous shallow-seagrass temperature logger programme is a distinct high-frequency data stream.

logger_source.source_role: Continuous summertime shallow-seagrass-bed temperature observations; independent of the Tampa fixed-transect focal response table.

tampa_registry_source.use: Transect identity and coordinates only; no focal occurrence/cover/eMoF response opened.

spatial_alignment_gate.rule: A logger deployment maps to its nearest Old Tampa Bay fixed transect by Haversine distance. Multiple deployments may map to one transect; the gate counts unique fixed transects.

decision_map.pass: A future/species-response contract may use only the predeclared <=1 km fixed-transect/logger mappings and must freeze temperature metrics before focal response access.
decision_map.temporal_pass_spatial_stop: The logger programme is high-frequency but not sufficiently co-located with fixed transects for direct Tampa response testing; do not expand the distance threshold after seeing focal outcomes.
decision_map.source_stop: Do not use this data stream for the fixed-transect mechanism test.

claim_boundary: Logger sites were designed for shallow Old Tampa Bay seagrass temperature work, not for the fixed-transect monitoring programme.
Spatial proximity does not make logger temperature identical to transect temperature.
This gate establishes source quality and spatial/temporal alignment only; it does not test a biological response.
The 1 km primary crosswalk threshold cannot be relaxed after this preflight result to obtain more matched transects.
